Hearth - a small chat app
=========================

How to start it
  Double-click Hearth.exe. Nothing needs installing.
  Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box because the app isn't
  signed by a company. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

Chat with each other
  Hearth opens in the "Home Network" community (HN, on the left). Everyone running Hearth
  on the same Wi-Fi or home network sees the messages there.
  The first time, Windows Firewall may ask about Hearth: allow it on private networks.
  It only works on the same network, not over the internet.

Video and screen sharing
  In the Home Network community, join the "Lounge" voice channel. Press "Video" to turn
  your camera on or "Share screen" to show a screen or one app window to everyone in the
  Lounge. You can pick the quality (480p to original size) and smoothness (5 to 60 frames
  a second); the gear button on the voice screen changes them while you're live.
  Click a box to make it big. Leaving the channel stops sharing.

Voice chat
  Everyone in the Lounge can talk and hear each other. Both of you need this version.
  Settings > Voice & sound: pick your microphone and speakers, test your mic, choose
  voice activity or push to talk, set volumes, and turn interface sounds on or off.
  Right-click a friend on the voice screen to change just their volume.
  Noise suppression (on by default) removes background noise from your mic.
  Headphones avoid echo.

Updates
  Hearth checks for new versions by itself and installs them when you close it, or
  right away with "Restart to update". Settings > Updates lets you check now or turn
  this off. Hearth keeps the previous version as Hearth.old.exe until its next start.

Sharing it with more friends
  Send this zip through a shared drive link (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox), a
  file-transfer site or a USB stick. Email and many chat apps block programs, even
  inside a zip. Steps are also in Hearth: Settings > Invite friends.

Everything else
  Friends and direct messages (the house button at the top left) are kept on your own
  computer, with sample people who reply. Turn that off in Settings > Chat.
  Settings is the gear at the bottom left.

Your messages and settings are saved in %APPDATA%\Hearth on your computer.
